_comment: Drop-in template for a new brand. All <PLACEHOLDER> values must be replaced before deploy. Items under 'secret' go to `wrangler secret put` (Worker) or `supabase secrets set` (Edge Function). Items under 'var' go in wrangler.toml [vars] section.

brand.name: <BRAND_NAME>
brand.tagline: <one-line marketing tagline for welcome email header>
brand.address: <physical address, used in welcome email footer + admin notice>
_setup_notes: These values populate the BRAND const in worker/index.ts.
Same socials must match the brand site's Footer.jsx + SchemaMarkup.jsx 'sameAs' array — Google flags inconsistent URLs as identity-graph noise.
accent_color is used in welcome email gold rule + NewsletterSignup buttons.

secret.BREVO_WEBHOOK_SECRET: <any random string; goes in Brevo webhook URL>

_setup_notes: EMAIL_LINK_SECRET signs unsubscribe + .ics calendar links. MUST match the Edge Function's secret of the same name.
BREVO_WEBHOOK_SECRET is used as a URL parameter (?secret=...) when Brevo posts to /webhooks/brevo. Treat as a shared secret.
REVIEW_EMAIL_TO is the admin email that /email/send checks JWT against — only this address can send campaigns.
Push secrets with: wrangler secret put <NAME>
ORDER_EMAIL_FROM must be a Brevo-verified sender. Verify a single address at app.brevo.com/senders/list (fast) OR your full domain via DNS for production.
Set ADMIN_NOTIFY_EMAIL to '' (empty string) to disable admin BCC on order confirmations + refunds.
Push secrets with: supabase secrets set <NAME>=<value>
Deploy with: supabase functions deploy send-order-email
Configure at app.brevo.com → Settings → Webhooks → Add Webhook → Transactional.
Free plan: 300 sends/day. Sufficient for newsletter + a few hundred contacts. Upgrade to Lite ($9/mo, 5k/day) when contact list crosses ~1k.
Sender verification REQUIRED before any send works. Either single-address verification (instant) or full-domain DKIM+SPF (production).
After first webhook fires, check wrangler tail to confirm events are reaching the Worker.

tables_created: email_contacts  (id, email UNIQUE, first_name, last_name, company_name, segment, subtype_tags TEXT[], merge_vars JSONB, status, source, notes, created_at, updated_at)
email_campaigns (id, name, subject, html_content, from_name, from_email, reply_to, segment_filter JSONB, recipients_count, status, sent_at, sent_by, created_at, updated_at)

email_logs      (id, campaign_id, recipient, contact_id, message_id, campaign_type, status, sent_at, delivered_at, opened_at, clicked_at, bounced_at, bounce_reason, raw_event JSONB, created_at, updated_at)
email_templates (id, type, lang, subject, heading, intro, outro, items_label, subtotal_label, shipping_label, total_label, ship_to_label, tracking_label, method_label, cta_label, UNIQUE(type,lang))
supabase_db.function_required: public.is_admin() — returns true if JWT email matches REVIEW_EMAIL_TO OR if auth.uid() has role='admin' in public.users
prerequisite_tables: public.users(id uuid, role text)        — used by is_admin(). Create if missing or rewrite is_admin().
public.newsletter_subscribers           — used by migration #2. Skip migration #2 if absent.
_setup_notes: Migrations are idempotent (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS + ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING). Re-applying is safe.
RLS is admin-only on all 4 tables. Worker uses service role to bypass RLS for writes.
Migration #1 seeds 2 example contacts. Migration #3 seeds 10 template rows (5 types × 2 langs).

expected_provisions: <ProtectedAdminRoute> wrapper — sample implementation in replication-guide step 6
frontend.config_file_to_edit: src/config/emailWorker.js → set EMAIL_WORKER_BASE_URL to your deployed Worker host

stripe_webhook_integration.owned_by: consumer — not bundled in this skill
stripe_webhook_integration.calling_pattern: POST $SUPABASE_URL/functions/v1/send-order-email with { order_id, type } and Bearer $SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
stripe_webhook_integration._setup_notes: Tracking emails are fired manually from /admin/orders. Abandoned-cart emails are fired by a scheduled function (not bundled) that scans for orders stuck at status='pending' for >2 hours.

smoke_test_sequence: 2. Subscribe via NewsletterSignup form → welcome arrives, admin notice arrives
3. Inspect email_contacts row created via DB trigger
4. Click unsubscribe in welcome email → confirmation page + DB status flips
6. Open test email → wrangler tail shows webhook event + email_logs status='opened'
